tools.name: home_assistant_states
tools.title: Home Assistant devices
tools.description: The user's smart home devices in Home Assistant and their states now: lights (detail: brightness), switches, fans, covers, climate, media players, locks, scenes, scripts, automations and buttons, as JSON [{id, name, state, area, detail}]. The whole home is a long list: give search (a room, a device's name, part of an id) when you know what you are looking for. sensors adds temperatures, humidity and door contacts (presence, occupancy and motion only if the user's Access allows them); use it only with search ("temperature", "lämpötila", a room), as a home has hundreds of them. The id is what home_assistant_set takes.

search.description: Only devices whose name, area or id has this text (any case)

sensors.description: Sensors and binary sensors too (read only)

tools.name: home_assistant_set
tools.title: Switch a Home Assistant device
tools.description: Put one Home Assistant device in a state: on or off (lights, switches, fans, climate, media players), close (covers), lock (locks), run (a scene, a script, a button; triggers an automation, whose conditions still apply). The user's Access decides whether Claude may also open a cover, unlock a lock or turn an automation on or off: the states it allows are the ones listed, and the command refuses the rest. The user allows each call on Nightdrive's confirmation card first, which shows the device's name and room from Home Assistant and the new state; a refusal there is their answer. Find the device's id with home_assistant_states. Answers with the device's state afterwards.

entity.title: Id
entity.description: The device's id, as home_assistant_states gives it (light.kitchen)

tools.name: home_assistant_brightness
tools.title: Dim a Home Assistant light
tools.description: Sets a dimmable light's brightness in percent; a light that is off turns on at it. Lights that only turn on and off, and other devices, refuse: home_assistant_states shows a light's brightness in its detail while it's on. To turn a light off, home_assistant_set. The user allows each call on Nightdrive's confirmation card first, which shows the light's name and room from Home Assistant, its brightness now and the new one; a refusal there is their answer. The user can undo it, back to the brightness it had (or off). Answers with the light's state afterwards.

entity.title: Id
entity.description: The light's id, as home_assistant_states gives it (light.kitchen)
